prompts.sd-segmented-atlas-prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / game sprite production.
Image 1 is the user's accepted SD explorer design reference and edit target.
Create one modular sprite-parts atlas preserving this EXACT character: the same
large head, short brown hair, warm skin, big expressive brown eyes, right-facing
three-quarter orientation, gray sleeveless shirt and charcoal shorts, same
compact SD body proportions. Do not redesign him or change to a tall character.
The output is a 1024x1024 transparent PNG arranged as exactly FOUR columns and
FOUR rows of 256x256 cells. No lines, borders, labels, text, checkerboard or UI.
Every part fits with a clear transparent margin within its own cell and never
overlaps another cell. Only draw the named part; omit surrounding body/context.
Parts are separated for a layered character animation, with hidden joint areas
filled in completely so no holes appear when they move. Use the SAME common
artwork scale for all cells; do not enlarge the small hands, feet or face marks.
Rows in reading order, left to right:
Row 1: (1) complete bald head including ears and neutral bare face surface, NO
hair, NO eyes, eyebrows or mouth, maintaining the reference head silhouette;
(2) neck and torso in the gray sleeveless shirt, from neck down to hips, no head
or arms; (3) far LEFT arm, from shoulder to wrist, no hand;
(4) near RIGHT arm from shoulder to wrist, no hand.
Row 2: (5) far LEFT hand; (6) near RIGHT hand;
(7) far LEFT leg including its half of shorts, from hip to ankle, no foot;
(8) near RIGHT leg including its half of shorts, from hip to ankle, no foot.
Row 3: (9) far LEFT bare foot; (10) near RIGHT bare foot;
(11) BACK hair as a separate complete brown silhouette behind the head;
(12) FRONT hair and fringe only, without any face pixels.
Row 4: (13) far LEFT eye; (14) near RIGHT eye;
(15) both eyebrows as a pair; (16) neutral mouth only.
Orient all parts as in the reference's neutral standing pose. Exactly one of each
named part, no extra limbs or duplicate hands. Keep left/far and right/near
anatomical identity, consistent outlines and pixel cluster style. Sharp clean
pixel artwork, flat limited shading, no painterly glow, blur or soft lighting.
Actually transparent RGBA background. This is a SINGLE parts atlas asset, not
a portrait or finished character sheet. Preserve the source character's identity
and all sixteen cell positions exactly.

observed_limitations: Output is 1254x1254, not the requested exact 1024 grid.
Parts need explicitly authored crop bounds, scale and attachment pivots.
Unaffected tiles in variant atlases are not byte-identical; only declared variant parts are used.
Artwork generation is not a fit, occlusion, motion, contact or release approval.
